positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Helping developers move faster by building scalable, reliable, and high-performance web experiences at GitHub.

positions.title: Sr. Director, Web Engineering
positions.description: Lead strategic development across web browsers, Smart TVs, and other devices, fostering alignment between business, engineering, and leadership to ensure seamless collaboration and impactful results.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Discussions · Team Leadership · Debugging · Technical Understanding · Communication · Live Events · Architecture Frameworks · Streaming Media · Testing Tools

positions.title: Director, Web Engineering
positions.description:
Build and guide Web Engineering teams across multiple platforms and projects.
Define development strategic, focus mainly on performance, scalability and monitoring.
Implement innovative technologies and processes.
Promote cross team communication and cooperation.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: In charge of general web application architecture. On a serverless platform based on react-redux over Nextjs framework. Responsable for integration of multiple services and third party libraries to support advertisement and tracking. In check with good performance and web vitals.

positions.title: Engineering Lead - Performance Team
positions.description: Lead the web development strategies mainly focus on performance, SEO and user experience. Defined better way to interact with apis and the cms using React / Node platform. Mentored and guided other developer to ensure on time deliveries and sync with the rest of the team.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
One of the main contributors to migrate the CMS monolithic architecture to a microservice one based on React / Node with server side rendering. Developed multiple reusable components to support multiple platforms including Jest - unit testing and building with Webpack.
In charge of developing the html, css, javascript assets related to new functionalities and widgets for different verticals.
Create Models, ModelViews and Free Markers Templates on JAVA based - Brightspot CMS to extend existing user experience in a MAC, Vagrant, Maven, Github, Jenkins type of environment.
Create css and javascript components using modular and object oriented approach.
Work with DFP and FreeWheel API’s to deploy effective and smart advertisement slots.

educations.schoolName: Technological University of Havana "José Antonio Echeverría"

honors.title: Second Place - Google NYC Modern Mobile Web Hackathon on 8/29
honors.description: Our team built a full Progressive Web App (PWA) for Univision Horoscopes section to improve mobile site performance and engagement. In the event participated companies like: Ford, AccuWeather, Satellite, CVS Pharmacy and Kroger. We got recognized with the Second Place.
